mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25% in a single month, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in non-farm payrolls indicate a strengthening labor market that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, rising residential construction permits (HOUST) above 1000 thousand units signal robust housing demand that increases consumer confidence and corporate revenues, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion when HOUST exceeds 1000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 in a single month, it signals a sharp manufacturing slowdown that increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal strong consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment periods (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
